_note: Content a screen must NOT show. This is the g2_1 class of bug: the
reference deliberately does not ask for registration documents on the
registration screen, and an implementation that helpfully adds the field
breaks the design while every positive assertion still passes.
Design screens (n1-n5) carry their forbidden list in
come from. This file is the allowlist for REFERENCE screens, where the
'deliberately not asked' rule lives in English prose that no parser can
turn into a selector. Every entry says why it is here.
text: matched case-insensitively against the screen's visible text.
selector: matched as a DOM selector that must have zero matches.

g2_1.why: The reference's green callout on g2_1 says registration documents, certificates and letterheads are deliberately not asked here — they come later, and only once wider terms need them. A registration-number field on this screen is the bug this whole gate exists to catch. Also asserted directly in apps.spec.js; kept here so the rule survives if that test is rewritten.

p2_21.why: p2_21's rule is that a mismatch is somebody named, not a status: no row may be described as dropped. The reference callout says none of this is a worker's fault and none of it reaches a worker's app.

p1_2.why: p1_2 — a role is held, not just recorded. Authority is granted by somebody with the authority to grant it; a screen offering self-selection would make it self-declaration (same rule as design screen n1).
